doc.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Luther Henderson and Dudley Brooks, Great Lakes arrangers
summary: The two staff arrangers and Terry's nickname habit.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Luther Henderson and Dudley Brooks were two of our chief arrangers on staff at Great Lakes. Of course Dudley Brooks had been ensconced in the Hollywood scene, so he was doing a lot of writing for movies, etc., in Hollywood, but Luther – Luke, I used to call him – he’s an East Coaster. He’d been writing a lot – he’s a piano player, and Dudley’s also a piano player – he had been writing a lot for people on the East Coast. As a matter of fact I saw Luther two weeks ago. He came someplace where I was. Someplace where I was receiving a little award for some sort, and Luke came along.
Luke? I don’t know. I always have a thing for nicknaming people.
It just pops into your head.
It just popped into my head.
